part1: Where is your hometown?
What is your hometown famous for?
Has your hometown changed in recent years?
Would you like to live there in the future?

part2.title: Describe a place in your hometown that you like to visit.
part2.cueCard:
Describe a place in your hometown that you like to visit.

You should say:
- where it is
- what you do there
- who you go with

and explain why you like it.

part3: How important is it for people to feel a connection to their hometown?
Do you think modern cities have less character than older cities?
How might urban development affect local communities?

part1: Are you a student or do you work?
What do you study or what do you do for a living?
Why did you choose this field?
What do you find most difficult about your work or studies?

part2.title: Describe a skill you would like to learn.
part2.cueCard:
Describe a skill you would like to learn.

You should say:
- what the skill is
- why you want to learn it
- how you would learn it

and explain how it would help you in the future.

part3: Why do people choose to learn new skills as adults?
How has the way people work changed in the past 20 years?
Do you think artificial intelligence will replace many jobs?

part1: What do you do in your free time?
Do you have any hobbies?
Have your hobbies changed since you were a child?
Do you prefer indoor or outdoor activities?

part2.title: Describe a hobby you would like to take up.
part2.cueCard:
Describe a hobby you would like to take up.

You should say:
- what it is
- why it interests you
- what equipment is needed

and explain how it would benefit you.

part3: Why do people in modern society seem to have less free time?
Are some hobbies better for mental health than others?
How important are hobbies for children's development?

part1: Do you use a smartphone often?
What apps do you use most every day?
Has technology improved your life?
What technology would you like to learn more about?

part2.title: Describe a piece of technology you find useful.
part2.cueCard:
Describe a piece of technology you find useful.

You should say:
- what it is
- how often you use it
- what it does

and explain why you find it useful.

part3: How has technology changed the way people communicate?
Are there any negative effects of technology on society?
Should children's screen time be limited?

part1: Do you like to travel?
Where would you like to visit in the future?
What was your most recent trip?
Do you prefer city trips or nature trips?

part2.title: Describe a memorable trip you have taken.
part2.cueCard:
Describe a memorable trip you have taken.

You should say:
- where you went
- who you went with
- what you did there

and explain why it was memorable.

part3: Why do people choose to travel?
How has travel changed in the last 30 years?
What are the benefits of cultural exchange through tourism?

part1: What is your favorite food?
Do you cook often?
Do you prefer eating at home or in restaurants?
Have your food preferences changed over time?

part2.title: Describe a traditional dish from your country.
part2.cueCard:
Describe a traditional dish from your country.

You should say:
- what it is
- how it is made
- when it is eaten

and explain why it is significant in your culture.

part3: How does food connect to a country's culture?
Why do some traditional foods disappear over time?
Should children learn cooking as a school subject?

part1: Do you read often?
What kinds of books do you enjoy?
Do you prefer paper books or e-books?
When did you last read for pleasure?

part2.title: Describe a book that influenced you.
part2.cueCard:
Describe a book that influenced you.

You should say:
- what the book is
- when you read it
- what it is about

and explain how it influenced you.

part3: How important is reading in modern society?
Why do fewer young people read books today?
Should governments do more to promote reading?

part1: Do you do any sports?
How often do you exercise?
Did you play sports as a child?
Do you prefer team sports or individual sports?

part2.title: Describe a sport you would like to try.
part2.cueCard:
Describe a sport you would like to try.

You should say:
- what the sport is
- why you want to try it
- what challenges it might have

and explain how you would prepare for it.

part3: Why is physical fitness important in everyday life?
Should governments invest more in public sports facilities?
Are professional athletes paid too much?

part1: What did you study at school?
What was your favorite subject?
Do you think your education has been useful?
Would you like to study more in the future?

part2.title: Describe a teacher who influenced you.
part2.cueCard:
Describe a teacher who influenced you.

You should say:
- who the teacher was
- what they taught
- how they taught

and explain how they influenced you.

part3: How has education changed in your country in recent years?
Should students be allowed to choose their own subjects?
Is online education as effective as traditional classroom learning?

part1: What environmental problems are common in your area?
What do you personally do to protect the environment?
Do you think your country is doing enough for the environment?
Which environmental problem do you think is most serious?

part2.title: Describe a natural place you have visited.
part2.cueCard:
Describe a natural place you have visited.

You should say:
- where it is
- when you went there
- what you did there

and explain why you remember it.

part3: How can individuals reduce their environmental impact?
Should companies pay more for the pollution they cause?
Will technology be enough to solve climate change?
